visual_text: Your knee X-ray is a poor guide to your pain
Many people with arthritis changes on the X-ray have little pain. Many with knee pain have fairly normal X-rays.
Bedson and Croft, BMC Musculoskelet Disord 2008
Within one person, the worse knee on X-ray is more often the painful one.
Typical symptoms: an X-ray is not needed to diagnose knee osteoarthritis
Something unusual or another possible cause: imaging helps. Unexpected worsening: consider imaging
Better questions than 'what does the X-ray show?'
What can I do to keep this knee moving?
What should make us look again?
Bunzli et al., Clin Orthop Relat Res 2019
alt_text: Two schematic knee outlines, one with a narrowed joint space and one with a normal space, above an older man walking and an older woman seated. Many people with X-ray arthritis changes have little pain; many with knee pain have fairly normal X-rays.
